name: Junior frontend dev -> Senior React role

job.title: Senior React Engineer
job.description:
Lumen Health is hiring a Senior React Engineer to lead development of our patient-facing web app. You will own architecture decisions for a large React + TypeScript codebase, mentor engineers, and partner with design on an accessible component library.

Requirements:
- 5+ years building production web apps with React
- Deep TypeScript experience
- State management (Redux Toolkit, React Query)
- GraphQL APIs
- Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Testing with Jest and React Testing Library, Cypress for E2E
- Performance profiling and Core Web Vitals
- CI/CD with GitHub Actions
- Experience mentoring other engineers

Nice to have: Next.js, Storybook, design systems, healthcare/HIPAA experience.

professionalSummary.summary: Frontend developer with 2 years of experience building React interfaces for internal tools and marketing sites.

achievements: Built a React dashboard in TypeScript that dispatchers use to track 1,200 daily shipments
Moved server state from custom hooks to React Query, removing about 800 lines of fetching code
Wrote Jest and React Testing Library tests for shared form components
Fixed keyboard navigation and color contrast issues flagged in an accessibility audit
Paired with a senior engineer to set up GitHub Actions for lint and test on every PR
Built landing pages for 6 client campaigns in Next.js and Tailwind
Improved Lighthouse performance scores by lazy-loading images
